note: Conversion rules shipped with the tool. A user file passed in the add-on is matched first; these are the fallback. Properties a profile does not cover are reported as unmapped, never dropped silently.

profiles.note: Four-layer vertex-colour blend shader (madout2: Custom/Environment/PBR_blend_materials). Blender builds layer 1, the fill layer, and reports layers 2-4 as unmapped: reproducing the height blend needs its own node group (M5). Without this rule the layer that wins the base-colour slot depends on which file name the postfix heuristic reads first, and tiling stays 1:1 because this shader keeps it in _Tile1x/_Tile1y rather than in the texture slot.
